messages:
jordan: Heads-up 14 12 Copy action on the Model snapshot card is silent to screen readers. Visual toast shows \'Copied\' but VoiceOver/NVDA hear nothing. Repro: tab to card -> press Copy -> toast visible -> SR silent.
marta: Oof. Is the toast in an aria-live region? We intentionally keep many toasts non-announced to avoid spam, but copy confirmations are important.
kevin: If we add a polite announcer that only gets updated for copy actions, we can avoid spamming. Simple approach: single DOM node near app root with role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true".
sun: Also noticed the focus halo on the Copy icon button in dark theme is very faint. Auto-scan reports focus outline contrast ~1.7:1. That fails our 3:1 focus contrast target. Screenshot: https://attachments/reports/focus-snap-901.png
jordan: Minimal patch proposal: (1) add aria-label="Copy snapshot ID" to the icon button; (2) create `#a11y-snapshot-announcer` role="status" aria-live="polite" node and write "Snapshot ID copied to clipboard" on success; (3) tweak dark theme focus ring color to #7FC3FF (3.2:1). Also debounce announcer updates for 800ms and clear after 1s.
marta: Example announce helper: 
```
function announceOnce(msg) {
  const n = document.getElementById('a11y-snapshot-announcer');
  if (!n) return;
  n.textContent = msg;
  setTimeout(() => { n.textContent = ''; }, 1000);
}
```
kevin: Add aria-atomic="true" so some readers always read the full string. Also check we don't double-announce if other toasts use live regions.
sun: I'll run a quick color pass and add a small CSS variable fallback for older browsers.
a11y_bot: Scan results: toast text contrast ok (5.0:1). Focus ring in dark theme fails (1.7:1). Missing aria-label on copy icon. No aria-live announcer detected. Recommend patch + e2e keyboard tests.
jordan: I'll open a tiny PR with tests: unit test to assert aria-label + announcer text mutation, and e2e keyboard flow (tab to card, press Enter, expect announcer text). Will include both light/dark theme runs.
marta: Link when ready. Also add CHANGELOG accessibility note.
kevin: PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5012 - includes aria-label, announcer node, dark focus color tweak, debounce, and tests.
jordan: Thanks. Quick UX nit: keep the toast message unchanged for visual parity; announcer message can be slightly different for clarity, e.g., "Snapshot ID copied".
sun: Merged small color tweak commit into PR branch.
a11y_bot: CI reminder: include macOS + Windows keyboard e2e runs to avoid regressions.
jordan: Resolving thread once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
